# Morgonkoll: Ny våg av attacker i Mellanöstern – oljan fortsätter upp

**Feed**: dagen-med-di  
**Published**: 2026-07-09  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

A news-driven morning episode (DI Morgonkoll). Renewed US strikes on Iran pushed oil toward $79/bbl and weighed on Asian markets, while Wall Street tech rallied on AI and chip news (Broadcom–Apple deal, Nvidia China reports). US long rates rose on inflation worries after divided Fed minutes. In Sweden, the main items were Revolution Race's acquisition of Icaniwill, the competition authority closing its Hemnet probe, Nivika's report, a Fastpartner insider buy and several upcoming property-company reports. The host reported news without giving explicit investment calls.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟠 RVRC — Revolution Race | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Acquiring Icaniwill for about SEK 700m; the company expects the deal to add to earnings in 2026-2027.

#### Reasoning

This is reported company news, not a host recommendation. Buying a growth brand, paid from cash, credit lines and treasury shares, with a stated positive earnings effect, is a possible medium-term catalyst. The earnout of up to SEK 175m depends on Icaniwill hitting its growth targets. Worth watching integration and whether the earnings boost shows up.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Icaniwill misses its growth targets
- if the acquisition does not add to earnings in 2026-2027
- if more debt financing strains the balance sheet

> *"Vidare bedömer bolaget att förvärvet kommer ha en positiv effekt på vinsten under 2026 och 2027."*

---

### 🟠 FPAR-A — Fastpartner | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Chairman Sven-Olof Johansson bought SEK 5.6m of shares, two days after his previous purchase.

#### Reasoning

Repeated insider buying by the chairman, who is also the main owner, is a positive signal of insider confidence. The host only reported the purchase and gave no view of their own. This makes it a speculative watch signal ahead of property-sector reports.

#### Sell Triggers

- if insiders start selling
- if property valuations or interest rates move against the sector

> *"Fastpartners ordförande Sven-Olof Johansson köpt aktier i bolaget till ett värde om 5,6 miljoner kronor."*

---

### 🟠 HEM — Hemnet | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Competition authority closed its investigation into Hemnet's alleged abuse of a dominant position.

#### Reasoning

The closed probe removes a regulatory overhang on Hemnet's pricing ('Sälj först betala sen') and its broker partnerships. This is news reporting with no host opinion, so it is only a speculative positive watch signal.

#### Sell Triggers

- if regulators reopen the probe
- if broker chains push back on Hemnet's pricing

> *"Konkurrensverket avslutar sin utredning mot Hemnet rörande missbruk av dominerande ställning inom digital bostadsannonsering."*
